movesets.name: Calm Mind
movesets.description:
Calm Mind Enamorus-T is a niche setup sweeper that leverages its high Special Attack and bulk to trade against tier staples like Ting-Lu, Dragonite, and Great Tusk. Earth Power is necessary coverage to hit targets like Gholdengo, Iron Moth, and Galarian Slowking, all of which could otherwise check Enamorus-T, while Mystical Fire is an option to hit common switch-ins like Corviknight and Air Balloon Gholdengo. Mystical Fire also comes with the benefit of reducing the Special Attack of switch-ins like Assault Vest Primarina, helping to turn them into setup fodder. Draining Kiss with Taunt is an alternative option on Enamorus-T to help it break through bulkier walls like Blissey and Clodsire. Leftovers allows Enamorus-T to leverage its massive bulk and stay healthy while setting up Calm Mind boosts—alternatively, Heavy-Duty Boots can be considered to let Enamorus-T find more opportunities to switch in and is an option for teams that lack an entry hazard remover. Tera Ground lets Earth Power OHKO Gholdengo and 2HKO Galarian Slowking while flipping the matchup against Raging Bolt. This also gives Enamorus-T a resistance to Poison-type moves such as Iron Moth's Sludge Wave while granting it an OHKO against Garganacl at +1. Tera Poison is used for an immunity to Toxic, as well as a resistance to Poison-type moves from the aforementioned Iron Moth and Pecharunt and a good neutral defensive typing against threats like Darkrai, Kingambit, and Heavy Slam Zamazenta. Finally, Tera Fairy notably achieves a 2HKO at +1 on physically defensive Moltres with Moonblast. 248 HP / 184 SpA / 76 Spe is an alternative spread that can be used on Taunt variants, running enough Speed to outrun Blissey and reliably beat it one-on-one.

Calm Mind Enamorus-T fits best on bulky offense teams on which its wallbreaking capabilities and unique defensive profile is appreciated. One amazing partner for it is Ogerpon-W, since it can pivot with U-turn and bring in Enamorus-T against Dragon-types like Dragonite and Dragapult. Notable damage thresholds such as an OHKO with +1 Moonblast on Ogerpon-W with any entry hazard damage means that Enamorus-T wants hazards to help it wallbreak, so hazard setters like Ting-Lu, Great Tusk, and Hisuian Samurott as well as Knock Off users such as Ogerpon-W and Weavile are recommended. Ting-Lu in particular makes for a great partner, as Enamorus-T appreciates the hazards and chip damage that Ting-Lu provides along with its ability to switch into threats like Gholdengo and Iron Crown. Meanwhile, Ting-Lu appreciates how well Enamorus-T can be used to switch into Fighting-type attacks targeted at Ting-Lu such as Great Tusk's Close Combat, while its ability to stifle more niche options like Nasty Plot Hydrapple does not go unnoticed. Enamorus-T can struggle with faster Steel-types such as Iron Crown and Tinkaton, so teammates such as Cinderace and Iron Treads are recommended, and their ability to remove hazards is particularly appreciated by Leftovers variants. Enamorus-T can struggle to break Ground-immune Fairy-resistant Pokemon such as Corviknight and Moltres, so Pokemon that break these such as Raging Bolt, Ogerpon-W, and Ursaluna are therefore good partners. Ursaluna in particular fits onto Trick Room teams that Enamorus-T can sometimes find its home on — these typically opt for Choice Specs, but a more offensive Calm Mind Enamorus-T with Moonblast can also be paired with Trick Room setters like Cresselia to flip the script on faster checks like Kyurem and Iron Moth. Offensive Steel-types such as Gholdengo and Kingambit also help Enamorus-T wallbreak, as they can similarly wear down shared checks such as Moltres and Corviknight while being able to take advantage of Galarian Slowking and, in the case of Kingambit, opposing Gholdengo. Finally, Enamorus-T's low Speed makes Thunder Wave support from the likes of Gholdengo and Galarian Slowking effective against checks like Kingambit, while naturally fast Pokemon such as Zamazenta and Dragapult can provide more direct speed control.

movesets.name: Choice Specs
movesets.description:
Choice Specs Enamorus-T is a powerhouse under Trick Room with respectable bulk, which helps it to check top threats like Great Tusk by avoiding a 2HKO from Ice Spinner, and an immunity to Spikes. Moonblast threatens an OHKO on Fairy-weak Pokemon with the notable exceptions of a 2HKO on Ting-Lu and Assault Vest Hoopa-U. Earth Power hits premier Steel- and Poison-types in the tier, enabling it to OHKO Iron Moth and Iron Treads as well as 2HKO Galarian Slowking and Iron Crown without Assault Vest. Mystical Fire hits Ground-immune Steel-types such as Air Balloon Tinkaton, Air Balloon Gholdengo, and Corviknight. Mystical Fire's Special Attack drop allows Enamorus-T to survive Make It Rain from Gholdengo and Tachyon Cutter from Assault Vest Iron Crown, as well as prevent a 2HKO Darkrai’s Sludge Bomb or prevent an OHKO from Tera Poison Darkrai’s Sludge Bomb. Because Enamorus-T already has great coverage, Draining Kiss is chosen to maximize longevity and is able to pick off chipped or Fairy-weak targets, with it OHKOing Dragapult, Hisuian Samurott, Weavile, and Darkrai. Speed is minimized for usage in Trick Room and HP is left at an odd number to maximize opportunities to enter the field after Stealth Rock. Tera Fairy removes the Stealth Rock weakness, a major nuisance of Enamorus-T, as well as guaranteeing an OHKO with Moonblast on targets such as Kingambit, defensive Landorus-T, and Gliscor after Stealth Rock. Tera Fairy also powers up Draining Kiss, which gives Enamorus-T significantly more recovery while netting the OHKO on Zamazenta, Raging Bolt, and Kyurem and getting a 2HKO on Kingambit, Ogerpon-W, and Ting-Lu.

Trick Room is the only viable style for Choice Specs Enamorus-T, and these teams benefit from its low Speed and absurd damage output. Thus, Cresselia and Hatterene are essential partners, as they're the best Trick Room setters, with both able to provide a crucial Lunar Dance or Healing Wish, respectively, to rejuvenate Enamorus-T. With Lunar Dance or Healing Wish able to heal it up later, Enamorus-T can be played way more aggressively, lending itself even more value out of its damage output. This recovery becomes even more important since Enamorus-T gets chipped down quickly by Stealth Rock, though Hatterene's Magic Bounce is great for Enamorus-T because it blocks Stealth Rock. On the other hand, Cresslia's great bulk allows it to switch into attacks like Ice Spinner and Discharge for Enamorus-T, which is especially useful due to Choice Specs locking Enamorus-T into potentially ineffective moves. Cresselia appreciates Enamorus-T's ability to shrug off Dark-type attacks from threats such as Hisuian Samurott and Kingambit. Common offensive Trick Room partners like Kingambit and Iron Hands appreciate Enamorus-T's ability to switch into the tier's Ground-types such as Great Tusk, Ting-Lu, Gliscor, and Landorus-T, all of which are threatened by Moonblast. Ursaluna is a strong partner for Enamorus-T, switching into Electric-type moves from Raging Bolt and Zapdos and threatening special walls that Enamorus-T can struggle against like Clodsire and Blissey. Meanwhile, Enamorus-T can break physical walls that Ursaluna is annoyed by such as Corviknight, Skarmory, and Zamazenta.

movesets.name: Sheer Force
movesets.description: Enamorus-T's excellent Special Attack, solid bulk, and plentiful coverage options make it a decent wallbreaker able to threaten common special walls like Swampert and Empoleon. Earth Power threatens Fire-types such as Heatran, Iron Moth, and Ceruledge as well as non-Ground-immune Empoleon and Gholdengo, while Mystical Fire threatens non-Well-Baked Body Steel-types like Corviknight, Gholdengo, and Kingambit. Superpower nails special walls like Blissey, Ground-immune Empoleon, and Hisuian Goodra, while Grass Knot specifically targets Swampert, guaranteeing a KO on it after a Moonblast. A Rash nature is used when running Superpower; otherwise, Modest is optimal. Special sweepers and cleaners like Scream Tail and Azelf appreciate Enamorus-T being able to threaten their walls like Swampert and Empoleon, letting them clean late-game. Entry hazard support from the likes of Ting-Lu and Garchomp is greatly appreciated, as it helps Enamorus-T break through walls like RegenVest Manaphy and Meloetta that it can otherwise struggle to break through. Enamorus-T's awful Speed leaves it outsped and OHKOed by many offensive threats like Iron Boulder, Gholdengo, and Chien-Pao, making teammates that can deal with them and pivot it in like Corviknight, RegenVest Swampert, and Primarina, respectively, good partners.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 5 onwards

Price Range: 8-9 points

Overview: Enamorus-T is a powerful special attacker with great base offenses and defenses as well as plentiful coverage, functioning as a decent wallbreaker or setup sweeper. With its strong STAB Moonblast and Draining Kiss, wide variety of coverage, and strong setup options combined with its great natural bulk, it will often be able to dish out considerable damage. However, Enamorus-T often goes unchosen due to its poor Speed, lack of reliable recovery, and reliance on Heavy-Duty Boots.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Wallbreaker: Enamorus-T can OHKO or 2HKO most of its opposition holding Choice Specs or Life Orb and using powerful attacking options. With two key immunities to Ground and Dragon and above-average defenses, it can pivot onto the field relatively easily to exert offensive pressure and break more passive teams, though it can quickly get weakened if it opts to use damage-boosting items rather than Heavy-Duty Boots.

Setup Sweeper: Enamorus-T can utilize a variety of setup options to break through opposing teams. With Agility and some Speed investment, it can outspeed anything with 124 base Speed or less after setting up while maintaining a Modest nature for maximum damage, leaving room for 3 attacks or Calm Mind sets to burn through frail or weakened teams. With Calm Mind and Draining Kiss, Enamorus-T can become an unbreakable wall, keeping itself healthy while continuously boosting both its special stats and having room for coverage against Fairy-resistant foes or Iron Defense to stop physical revenge killers.

Utility: While much less common than the other two roles and less viable than on Enamorus due to its much lower Speed, Enamorus-T has access to support moves such as Taunt and Healing Wish to support its teammates while still exerting offensive pressure. It can also serve as a decent check against some wallbreakers with its resistances.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Moonblast, Draining Kiss, Alluring Voice, Play Rough

Setup Moves: Agility, Calm Mind, Iron Defense

Utility Moves: Taunt, Healing Wish, Substitute

Coverage: Earth Power, Mystical Fire, Grass Knot, Focus Blast, Superpower, Psychic, Iron Head, Sludge Bomb, Tera Blast

Niche Moves

Fly: Fly is Enamorus-T’s only Flying-type STAB move outside of Tera Blast, so it can be used with Power Herb to damage specially defensive Fairy-resistant foes like Volcarona.

Endure: In tandem with Custap Berry, Enamorus-T can get a surprise attack in on a faster revenge killer.

Common Items

Heavy-Duty Boots: Since Enamorus-T is weak to Stealth Rock, Heavy-Duty Boots can make it safer to switch in multiple times if entry hazard removal is limited.

Choice Specs: Choice Specs allows Enamorus-T to hit as hard as possible, giving it the potential to KO frail foes and do large amounts of damage to bulky Pokemon without needing a turn to set up.

Leftovers: For Calm Mind and Iron Defense sets, Leftovers provides passive recovery to allow Enamorus-T to set up without relying solely on Draining Kiss or Rest to keep itself healthy.

Niche Items

Damage-boosting Items: Enamorus-T normally needs more breaking power without being locked into one move, making Life Orb and Pixie Plate solid options, especially for Agility sets. Draining Kiss can help negate the additional damage of Life Orb as well.

Weakness Policy: Enamorus-T has enough bulk to take a super effective hit while setting up Agility, allowing it to boost its attacking stats without needing Calm Mind if the opponent does not predict its item correctly.

Kee Berry: For sets where Enamorus-T wants Calm Mind and either three attacking moves or RestTalk with no room for Iron Defense, Kee Berry can provide a Defense boost to prevent it from being 2HKOed by physical attackers, allowing it to set up and heal without being as threatened by physical attackers or losing potentially crucial coverage.

Resistance Berries: Enamorus-T has five weaknesses, and while it normally survives at least one unboosted hit, a resistance Berry allows it to withstand a boosted or Choice attack and knock out the foe in return.

Assault Vest: Assault Vest can help Enamorus-T deal with opposing special attackers while still utilizing its many coverage options.

Mental Herb: Taunt and Encore can easily put a stop to Enamorus-T trying to set up with Agility, Calm Mind, or Iron Defense, so Mental Herb can allow it a single extra turn to bypass the disrupting effects and attack before being locked into a single move or forced to no longer set up.

Tera

Enamorus-T is a great secondary Tera Captain, as Tera enhances its wallbreaking capabilities, gives it defensive options, and allows it to make offensive use of its secondary typing, although it does have significant Tera Captain competition in the same price range. Tera Fairy makes Moonblast incredibly spammable and removes Enamorus-T’s weakness to Stealth Rock. Tera Ground and Fire are strong non-STAB Tera types that boost its coverage moves against common Moonblast-resistant foes and flip its weaknesses. Tera Flying allows Enamorus-T to use Tera Blast on Choice Specs, Agility, and Calm Mind sets as an alternative to non-STAB coverage. Tera Water, Steel, and Poison provide defensive utility and allow Enamorus-T to set up in front of foes that pressure it with super effective damage.

Draft Strategy

Enamorus-T requires lots of support, but it can be a solid addition to teams that want an alternative setup sweeper or a bulky Fairy-type. It is not a Pokemon a draft should be built around, but rather, it complements higher-tiered Pokemon. While it is incredibly slow, it can take hits and be a great wallbreaker regardless, and it can even be used with Trick Room in niche scenarios.

Ground-types: Ground-types help deal with Enamorus-T's weaknesses to Electric, Poison, and Steel, making Pokemon like Great Tusk and Iron Treads solid partners.

Pivots: While Enamorus-T is bulky enough to survive multiple neutral hits, it performs best at dealing damage and setting up when it can come in for free, so both fast pivots that force switches such as Meowscarada and slow pivots that can regenerate such as Slowking can facilitate Enamorus-T to maintain constant pressure on the opponent.

Entry Hazard Removers: Enamorus-T appreciates not being reliant on Heavy-Duty Boots, as other items like Choice Specs, Leftovers, and Life Orb all provide it with far more value. Due to this, having a team with multiple entry hazard removal options such as Terapagos and Corviknight can be vital to allowing Enamorus-T the item freedom it desires.

Entry Hazard Setters: Enamorus-T often barely misses out on KOs with Choice Specs attacks on full health targets, meaning the extra chip damage from Stealth Rock and Spikes can often make the difference on knocking out an foe or leaving it at low health. Toxic Spikes can also be incredible paired with Enamorus-T’s more defensive sets, applying passive damage to the foe while Enamorus-T sets up its defenses and keeps itself healthy.

Checks and Counters

Faster Wallbreakers: Faster Pokemon, especially those with super effective STAB options such as Iron Moth and Gholdengo, can threaten to KO Enamorus before it can move.

Fairy-resistant Foes: Certain Pokemon that resist Fairy, such as Moltres and Corviknight, have secondary typings that make them less easily covered by Earth Power, Mystical Fire, and Psychic and thus take minimal damage from Enamorus-T.

Toxic: Toxic can quickly chip down Enamorus-T’s health in tandem with Protect or Substitute and is commonly learned by Poison-types that like to switch in on and outspeed Enamorus-T.

Taunt / Encore: Taunt and Encore disrupt Enamorus-T’s setup sets due to its low Speed. Specifically, Encore can be used to force Enamorus-T into setting up endlessly if a faster user switches in on a Calm Mind or Iron Defense.
